content.title: About
content.content: Layer dip is a ready‑to‑eat multi‑layered sauce made from sour cream, cheese, aromatic herbs, and finely chopped vegetables. It is designed for serving with chips, crackers, veggie sticks, and other snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Layer dip is a popular party staple because of its convenience and bold flavor.
The first commercial version appeared in the United States in the early 2000s.
A typical recipe contains up to five distinct layers, each with its own taste and texture.
Some versions replace sour cream with yogurt to lower the calorie count.
The dip can be easily veganized by swapping dairy components for plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: Rich in probiotics
items.content: The sour cream and yogurt base provide live cultures that support gut microbiota.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: The cheese layer supplies a notable amount of calcium important for bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Herbs and vegetables add vitamin B6 and folate, aiding metabolic processes.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Unlike many sauces, layer dip contains virtually no added sugars.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Fresh veggies and greens are rich in vitamin C and carotenoids, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: The dairy‑based formulation may cause discomfort for people who cannot digest lactose.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cheese and sour cream can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Some varieties contain up to 400 mg of sodium per 100 g, which may be a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Short shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the dip refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve layer dip chilled in a bowl alongside chips, crackers, fresh vegetable sticks, or pretzels. It also works well as a spread for sandwiches and burgers.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package in a cool, dry place. After opening, store in the refrigerator at 1‑4 °C and use within a week. Discard if it develops a sour smell or off‑color.
